assumptions: synthetic_historical_candle_quote; not bookTicker; Stage 3.2.4 research only

Signal is generated only after candle N closes. Earliest simulated fill uses candle N+1 open as mid, then frozen synthetic spread and slippage. Missing N+1 cancels the pending fill (no fabrication). If N+1 open ask falls outside the signal stop/target band, the pending entry is cancelled (no stop/target rewrite) and candle N+1 is still evaluated. Observation quotes at decision time use candle N close mid and are labelled synthetic. Decision/position timestamps are aligned to the fill instant for PaperBroker validation. Quotes are synthetic candle-derived mid±spread — not historical L2 / bookTicker. Intra-bar protective stop execution is not simulated on this path. Tape (BINANCE_SPOT_LIVE_CAPTURE) and historical candle results must stay separate; historical results are not equivalent to live execution.
